+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import typing as t
+
+from .core import Command
+from .core import Group
+
+
+class CommandDecoratorTypeError(Group):
+    """A :class:`~click.core.Group` whose :meth:`command` decorator raises
+    :exc:`TypeError` instead of :exc:`AssertionError` when called with a
+    callable together with other arguments.
+    """
+
+    @t.overload
+    def command(self, __func: t.Callable[..., t.Any]) -> Command: ...
+
+    @t.overload
+    def command(
+        self, *args: t.Any, **kwargs: t.Any
+    ) -> t.Callable[[t.Callable[..., t.Any]], Command]: ...
+
+    def command(
+        self, *args: t.Any, **kwargs: t.Any
+    ) -> t.Callable[[t.Callable[..., t.Any]], Command] | Command:
+        """A shortcut decorator for declaring and attaching a command to
+        the group. This takes the same arguments as :func:`command` and
+        immediately registers the created command with this group by
+        calling :meth:`add_command`.
+
+        To customize the command class used, set the
+        :attr:`command_class` attribute.
+
+        Raises :exc:`TypeError` if a callable is passed together with
+        other arguments.
+        """
+        from .decorators import command
+
+        func: t.Callable[..., t.Any] | None = None
+
+        if args and callable(args[0]):
+            if not (len(args) == 1 and not kwargs):
+                raise TypeError(
+                    "Use 'command(**kwargs)(callable)' to provide arguments."
+                )
+            (func,) = args
+            args = ()
+
+        if self.command_class and kwargs.get("cls") is None:
+            kwargs["cls"] = self.command_class
+
+        def decorator(f: t.Callable[..., t.Any]) -> Command:
+            cmd: Command = command(*args, **kwargs)(f)
+            self.add_command(cmd)
+            return cmd
+
+        if func is not None:
+            return decorator(func)
+
+        return decorator

@@ -0,0 +1,50 @@
+import pytest
+
+import click
+from click.command_decorator_type_error import CommandDecoratorTypeError
+
+
+def test_bare_callable_with_args_raises_type_error():
+    grp = CommandDecoratorTypeError("cli")
+
+    def f():
+        pass
+
+    with pytest.raises(TypeError, match=r"command\(\*\*kwargs\)\(callable\)"):
+        grp.command(f, name="x")
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("parens", [True, False])
+def test_command_registers(runner, parens):
+    grp = CommandDecoratorTypeError("cli")
+
+    if parens:
+
+        @grp.command()
+        def sub():
+            click.echo("ok")
+
+    else:
+
+        @grp.command
+        def sub():
+            click.echo("ok")
+
+    assert grp.commands["sub"] is sub
+    result = runner.invoke(grp, ["sub"])
+    assert result.output == "ok\n"
+
+
+def test_command_class_used():
+    class MyCommand(click.Command):
+        pass
+
+    class MyGroup(CommandDecoratorTypeError):
+        command_class = MyCommand
+
+    @MyGroup("cli").command(name="named")
+    def f():
+        pass
+
+    assert isinstance(f, MyCommand)
+    assert f.name == "named"
